content.purpose: Connects to Google Cloud Agent Platform and supports inference with Gemini, OpenMaaS, and custom-endpoint models.
content.whenToUse: Use it when an inference integration needs SDK, authentication, or endpoint guidance, or when troubleshooting request errors; it does not cover model deployment or evaluation.
content.outputs: It provides setup and troubleshooting guidance, along with Python SDK examples for Gemini, OpenMaaS, and custom-endpoint inference.

content.purpose: 連接 Google Cloud Agent Platform，並支援使用 Gemini、OpenMaaS 與自訂端點模型進行推論。
content.whenToUse: 當推論整合需要 SDK、驗證或端點設定指引，或需要排查請求錯誤時使用；此技能不涵蓋模型部署或評估。
content.outputs: 提供設定與疑難排解指引，以及 Gemini、OpenMaaS 和自訂端點推論的 Python SDK 範例。
